mapper.select: SELECT m.open_id AS "openId", MAX(m.create_time) AS "lastMessageAt", (SELECT content FROM crm_wechat_mp_message m2 WHERE m2.app_id = #{appId} AND m2.open_id = m.open_id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "lastContent", SUM(CASE WHEN m.direction = 'inbound' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "messageCount" FROM crm_wechat_mp_message m WHERE m.app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY m.open_id ORDER BY "lastMessageAt" DESC
SELECT * FROM crm_wechat_mp_message WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND open_id = #{openId} AND direction = 'inbound' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
